Restorative · Patient guide

Dental fillings in Gujranwala

A filling repairs a cavity or a small area of damaged tooth and restores its shape.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

A dentist may recommend a filling after finding decay or a small break. Sensitivity or food trapping can prompt an exam, and some cavities produce no symptoms.

What age group is it for?

Children and adults can need fillings. The type of tooth, the depth of the cavity and how soon a baby tooth may fall out affect the plan.

What happens at the appointment?

The dentist removes damaged or decayed material as appropriate, places the filling and checks how your teeth meet when you bite.

Does it hurt?

Local anaesthetic can reduce discomfort during treatment. Temporary sensitivity may occur afterward. Contact the clinic if your bite feels uneven or discomfort persists.

How much does it cost?

The amount of tooth being restored, the material and the number of surfaces affect the quote. Ask if the assessment or X-ray is separate.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
